street_id: SUMO street (edge) id; matches the street_id / edge ids used in the other tables
name: string
Street name from OpenStreetMap (empty when unnamed)
road_type: OpenStreetMap road class, e.g. primary, residential, trunk
geometry_wkt: Line geometry in WKT, longitude latitude (WGS84)
controlled_links: Number of movements (lane-to-lane connections) the light controls
people: Residents in the 200 m cell (INSEE Filosofi 2021)
adults_18_64: Residents aged 18 to 64 in the cell
commune_code: INSEE code of the commune (empty when outside the communes on the map)
jobs_estimate: Estimated jobs at the workplace: middle of its SIRENE size band, scaled so that La Rochelle totals INSEE's 50,497 jobs
home_commune_code: INSEE code of the commune where the commuters live
work_commune_code: INSEE code of the commune where they work
commuters_2022: Employed people commuting from the home to the work commune (INSEE 2022)
share_on_map: Share of the commune's residents living inside the simulated area (0-1)
car_share_to_work: Share of the commune's workers who drive to work, used to turn commuters into car trips (0-1)
road: Road number of the counted section, e.g. N237, D105
daily_vehicles_2023: Average daily traffic, both directions, 2023 (TMJA, DREAL Nouvelle-Aquitaine)
kind: entry or exit road (entry_roads.csv); trip kind in the demand tables: inside (home and work on the map), in (commuting into the map), out (commuting out), cross (commuting across), through (non-commuting through traffic)
daily_vehicles: Average daily traffic of the entry road (2,000 when no counting station is nearby)
commute_share: Share of the daily car commuters driving this morning (calibrated volume)
through_trips_thousands: Through trips added, in thousands (calibrated volume)
fit_sections: Counted sections used to choose the volume
fit_share_geh_under_5: Share of those sections with GEH under 5
fit_r2: R2 of simulated against counted flows on those sections
check_sections: Held-out counted sections (never used to choose)
check_share_geh_under_5: Share of held-out sections with GEH under 5
check_model_over_count: Median simulated / counted flow on the held-out sections
target_peak_hour_vehicles: 9 % of the daily traffic: the estimated 7:30-8:30 flow, both directions
simulated_peak_hour_vehicles: Simulated 7:30-8:30 flow, both directions (usual routes, seed 1)
geh: GEH statistic between simulated and target hourly flows (under 5 is a good match)
used_for: fit (used to choose the volume) or check (held out)
street_ids: Simulated streets matched to the section, one per direction, space separated
trip_id: Trip id; the same trip has the same id in every scenario of one seed (match on seed + trip_id)
departure_s: Actual departure time, seconds after midnight (empty if the car never entered)
usual_route: Route of a driver who knows the usual traffic (equilibrium of 20 repeated mornings), space-separated street ids
day: normal (ordinary morning) or incident (accident on the ring road 7:45-8:30)
app_share: Share of drivers following the live-rerouting app (0-1)
seed: Random seed of the traffic (same seed = same trips)
trips_7_to_9: Trips that start between 7:00 and 9:00 (the summarised drivers)
share_finished_by_11: Share of those trips finished by 11:00
mean_trip_time_s: Mean trip time from the requested departure, including any wait to enter (s); unfinished trips count with their time so far
mean_time_lost_s: Mean time lost compared with driving the same route freely, plus the wait to enter (s)
mean_reroutes_per_app_user: Mean number of route changes per app user
mean_trip_time_app_users_s: Mean trip time of app users (s)
mean_trip_time_others_s: Mean trip time of the other drivers (s)
teleports: Cars SUMO moved on after 5 minutes stuck (gridlock relief)
app_user: True if the driver follows the live-rerouting app
requested_departure_s: Requested departure time, seconds after midnight
arrival_s: Arrival time, seconds after midnight (empty if unfinished at 11:00)
finished: True if the trip ended before 11:00
time_lost_s: Time lost compared with driving the route freely, plus the wait to enter (s)
planned_route: Usual route at departure, space-separated street ids
driven_route: Route actually driven (after rerouting), space-separated street ids
begin_s: Start of the interval, seconds after midnight
end_s: End of the interval, seconds after midnight
entered: Cars that entered the street during the interval
left: Cars that left the street during the interval
speed_mps: Mean speed of the cars on the street (m/s)
occupancy_pct: Share of the street length occupied by cars (%)
travel_time_s: Mean time to drive the street (s)
vehicle_seconds: Total seconds spent on the street by all cars in the interval
blocked_lane: Lane nearly blocked by the accident
blocked_lane_speed_kmh: Speed allowed on the blocked lane during the accident (km/h)
other_lanes_speed_kmh: Speed on the other lanes during the accident (km/h)
network: Simulated network: two_road, two_road_long (2.4 km entry road) or grid
demand_veh_per_h: Traffic entering the network during one hour (vehicles per hour)
policy: no_information (fastest route in empty traffic), live (app users reroute), experienced (routes of drivers who know the usual traffic), forced (everyone on one road)
forced_route: Road everyone is forced on (calibration runs): short or long
averaging_window_s: Seconds of recent traffic the app averages into its travel times
recheck_period_s: Seconds between two route checks of an app user
synchronized_rechecks: True if all app users re-check at the same moments
trips: Trips due during the hour of traffic
share_finished: Share of trips finished within 2 hours
vehicle_hours: Total hours driven by all cars in the area during the interval
exit_rate_veh_per_h: Cars arriving per hour between minutes 15 and 60
share_on_detour: Share of cars (after minute 10) on the detour
share_on_detour_app_users: Share of app users on the detour
share_on_detour_others: Share of the other drivers on the detour
mean_trip_time_short_road_s: Mean trip time of cars on the short road (s)
mean_trip_time_detour_s: Mean trip time of cars on the detour (s)
minute_start_s: Start of the minute, seconds since the start of the simulation
cars_in_minute: Cars (app users, or everyone when nobody has the app) departing in that minute
app_share_pct: Share of drivers using the live-rerouting app in this scenario (%)
uses_app: yes if this driver follows the live-rerouting app, no otherwise
trip_minutes: Trip time from the moment the driver wanted to leave to arrival (minutes)
time_lost_minutes: Minutes lost in traffic compared with driving the same route on empty roads
finished_trip: yes if the trip ended before 11:00, no otherwise
avg_trip_minutes: Average trip time (minutes), from the moment the driver wants to leave to arrival
finished_pct: Share of trips finished (%): by 11:00 for La Rochelle, within 2 hours for the two-road runs
avg_trip_minutes_app_users: Average trip time of the drivers using the app (minutes)
avg_trip_minutes_others: Average trip time of the drivers not using the app (minutes)
cars_per_hour: Cars entering the street per hour during the interval
avg_speed_kmh: Average speed of the cars during the interval (km/h), weighted by the time each car spent driving
speed_vs_limit_pct: Average speed as a share of each street's speed limit (%), weighted by time driven: near 100 = traffic flows freely, low = jammed
traffic_per_hour: Requested traffic: cars wanting to enter the two-road network per hour (they may wait to enter when it is jammed)
app_users_on_detour_pct: Share of app users who took the detour (%)
all_on_detour_pct: Share of all drivers who took the detour (%)
time_clock: Start of the time interval, hh:mm
cars_on_road: Average number of cars driving in the network during the interval
time_lost_hours: Total hours lost in traffic by all cars during the interval (compared with free-flowing roads)
area: Commune containing the streets (La Rochelle, Aytré, Lagord, ...)
vehicle_km: Total kilometres driven by all cars in the area during the interval
home_area: Commune where the trip starts (home), or 'outside the map' for commuters from farther away and for through traffic
work_area: Commune where the trip ends (work), or 'outside the map' for commuters going farther away and for through traffic
